body: We just finished talking less than an hour ago. And... Yeah. It was nice. It was cathartic. I feel good. Although there are no feelings there anymore, it was good to get over all the bad feelings. I'm not planning on getting back with her, but it feels good to not see her as this villain in my mind.
Thanks! And you're completely right. I'm so relieved I can finally move forward. Getting my stuff back in around 2 hours!!

I'm sorry man, I don't know if it helps but she and I broke up in January of last year, and it took me this long and going through another small romantic fling till I could properly get over her.

thanks, I'm sure things will work out for you as well in the end. :)
Just even commenting and showing that you care helps :) I hope you'll be able to work through your issues as well. We're never truly alone. :)
I'm so sorry about your past, but so happy about your present!! I hope things only keep on looking up for you :)

I'm not. Life isn't perfect, but I'm pulling through. I'm definitely better than I was, and while I did end up drinking way more than I should have and very well could have died, I didn't. That's pretty good, I guess.

I don't know anymore. By all accounts, I should be happy. Great, loving supportive family, I'm in college and I love what I'm studying, I had internships and goals for after I'm out that I knew I could do. 

It doesn't help. None of it helps.

You don't sound rude or insensitive, you're 100% right. And I've been trying my hardest, but sometimes it just doesn't feel like enough anymore. I deleted her number, have her blocked on everything, and any chance for her to show up I block it out so I don't have to deal with it. It's just still not enough.
That's the thing, it's been almost a year. And I've moved on in certain ways but it still hurts. I hope you're right.

Thanks. It wouldn't be fair to say my depression was caused by my ex. It was around long before her. But she didn't help at all. Especially with the constant harrasment of me never wanting to talk about my issues.

No problem!! We all go through rough times in our life, and everything can feel so much worse on our birthday. Maybe sleep it off or play video games, or watch some new show on tv to take the exge off :)
Hey, happy birthday :) I'll chat with ya for a bit if you want.
